notes:
QUOTES: copied from PyMuPDF text extraction of the fetched PDFs; whitespace/line breaks collapsed to single spaces and Unicode NFKC applied (PDF ligatures 'fl'/'fi' expanded). Line-break hyphenations (e.g. 'quan- tum', 'SC- 086') are kept as extracted. Table quotes are table cells joined in extraction order. Every quote was machine-checked to occur in the extracted page text; locations give the PDF page (Krinner PDF pages = journal 'Page N of 29').
KRINNER (EPJ Quantum Technol. 6, 2 (2019), DOI verified via doi.org 302): DR is a customized Bluefors XLD400 (2x Cryomech PT 420). Table 1 MXC cooling power 19 uW at 20 mK; the same 19 uW at 20 mK is stated in Sect. 4.1 for Still heater 40 mW / flow 1.0 mmol/s, whereas all reference (heat-load extraction) measurements used P_Still=10.7 mW / 0.69 mmol/s giving only ~13 uW at 20 mK and ~5 uW at 13 mK. A checker should state which operating point it uses. Cooling powers are quoted at a stated temperature (P_MXC ~ n3 * T^2), not at base temperature. Measured passive loads per line carry large uncertainties (e.g. 0.013(6) uW drive, 0.020(16) uW NbTi output); the paper notes the measured MXC drive-line load exceeds the 0.004 uW estimate and lists possible reasons. Per-line loads were obtained by dividing cable-tree totals by the number of lines (25 drive, 25 flux, readout tree; drive values combine drive and readout trees). Active loads at 10 dBm/10 MHz are a single-line test signal, not operating levels; operating level is -78 dBm average at MXC per drive line (SI conversion -78 dBm = 10^(-7.8) mW = 1.585e-11 W, computed by me, rounded). The 50-qubit budget (Fig. 10) is only given graphically except the ~30% CP/MXC relative loads, 14 mK MXC operating temperature and 124 lines stated in Sect. 6. Uncertainties in parentheses are on last digits; SI values give central values only.
RAICU et al. (arXiv:2502.01945v3, 12 Dec 2025; published EPJ Quantum Technol. DOI 10.1140/epjqt/s40507-025-00427-1 per arXiv metadata, DOI verified via doi.org 302; I read the arXiv v3 PDF, not the journal version; the EPJ abstract page returned 403). Bluefors XLD1000-SL values: MXC 30 uW at 20 mK is attributed by the authors to Bluefors' specification (ref [13]); other-stage cooling powers (asterisked) are the authors' own heat-map estimates. Single-cable static loads are CALCULATED (thermal-conductivity model), not measured. The paper calls Krinner's system an 'LD400' while Krinner states XLD400.
THERMOMETRY: Myers, Li, Csathy (arXiv:2110.03788; Cryogenics DOI 10.1016/j.cryogenics.2021.103367 verified): RuO2 self-heating onset ~1 fW at MXC 6.7 mK, excitation ~100 pA; the 560 Ohm value is the nominal room-temperature chip resistance, not the mK resistance (I^2R with 560 Ohm would give 5.6e-18 W, so the low-T resistance must be much larger; not stated numerically). Samkharadze et al. (arXiv:1105.2350; Rev. Sci. Instrum. 82, 053902 per DOI redirect, DOI 10.1063/1.3586766 verified): RuO self-heating onset 100 aW and carbon 1 pW at 8 mK in liquid He-3; no excitation current/sample resistance for the 2DEG transport measurement is given (not_found). These are sensor/sample self-heating limits (local electron heating), distinct from the MXC stage cooling-power budget.
NOT FOUND: no Bluefors-authored document with per-line MXC heat load was fetched.
